question: A user wants Claude to find a spreadsheet they opened yesterday in Google Drive but does not remember its exact URL. What can the Drive connector do?
options: A) Only retrieve a file when the exact URL is provided by the user first.
B) List every file in the Drive account without offering any search tool.
C) Only access files explicitly shared with a separate Claude service account first.
D) Search through recently accessed documents in Drive to help find the file.
correct_answers: D) Search through recently accessed documents in Drive to help find the file.
explanations: Incorrect. A URL is one option, not a requirement; recent-document search is also supported.
Incorrect. Search capability is part of the connector, not just a flat unsearchable file list.
Incorrect. There is no separate service account requirement; the connector uses the user's own authenticated Drive access.
Correct. The Drive connector lets users search recently accessed documents, or paste a URL, so the file can be found without the exact link.
